description: WHICH COMPANY OWNS THIS IP -- the one tool to call for "who owns <IP>", "what network is <IP> in", "ASN / network range / owner of <IP>". Returns an `owner` block with ASN, owner name, network range (announced prefix and registry allocation) and owner domain, each stating its source (RIR registration data via RDAP, RIPE NCC routing data, PeeringDB); a field no source states is null with a reason, never guessed. Also returns the registry's full RDAP record (allocation, registrant, abuse contact) as `rdap`. Keyless; fails over between the registry's endpoints when one refuses the connection.

address.description: IP address, e.g. "8.8.8.8". Also accepted as `ip`.
